**Conditions:**

If the fourth element is a number, then it is to be coded as γ.

If the first element is a multiple of 3, then it is to be coded as β.

If the second and the fifth elements are symbols, then the codes for these two (the second and the fifth elements) are to be interchanged.

What will be the code for the following group? 9#@27

 (i)
 Fourth element is a number
 It is to be coded as γ
 
 

 (ii)
 First element is a multiple of 3
 It is to be coded as β
 
 

 (iii)
 Second and the fifth elements are symbols
 The codes for these two are to be interchanged
 
 

Given: 9#@27

Here, (i) and (ii) rules applies i.e. it is to be coded as γ and β respectively.

9 → coded as β

# → coded as I

@ → coded as F

2 → coded as γ

7 → coded as R

So, 9#@27 → Coded as βIFγR

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
